_not: Sefer tutorial'ı (Ömer 2026-10-13 onayı; tasarım docs/design/tutorial.md). Her düğümde TEK yeni şey, ders o anki savaşta / ekranda çıkar. Metinler oyun içi (İngilizce), her ders en çok 1-2 cümle. Mentor kutusu src/ui/lesson-box.ts, kurallar (saf) src/tutorial/lessons.ts, görülenler localStorage proto.tutorial.v1 (src/tutorial/store.ts). trigger.battle: savaş içi (node = düğüm id'leri, region = bölge; when: start = ilk oyuncu kararı, turn = N. oyuncu kararı, skill = melee/area skill seçilince, status = canlı bir birimde durum varken, ground = zemin etkisi varken, boss = boss rütbeli düşman varken; fallbackTurn: koşul hiç oluşmazsa bu karardan itibaren). trigger.screen: ekran dersleri (town, merchant, company, map, event, gear, endless). forced: yalnızca ilk savaş (Mill Road) adım adım zorunlu; await = next (düğme) | skill (temel saldırı düğmesi) | target (hedef seçilip saldırı yapılınca). codex: Codex > Lessons'ta görünen metin (yoksa text). place: bottom = kutu altta (Gear: torbayı kapatmasın). defeatHints: Bölüm III'te aynı savaş 2 kez kaybedilince savaş başında mentor ipucu (Codex'e girmez).

opening.text: Thugs on the mill road, and only you between them and the village. Steady now. I'll talk you through it.

lessons.title: The Turn Bar
lessons.text: The bar at the top shows who acts next. Faster fighters act more often.

lessons.title: Attacking
lessons.text: This is your attack. Press it.
lessons.codex: Your first skill is your basic attack. It costs nothing: pick it, then pick a target.

lessons.title: Choosing a Target
lessons.text: Now tap a glowing enemy to strike. Hover one first to preview the damage.
lessons.codex: After you pick a skill, the enemies it can reach glow. Hover one to preview the damage, tap it to strike.

lessons.title: Skills and MP
lessons.text: Stronger skills cost MP, which refills a little every turn. A skill with a cooldown rests for a few turns after use.

lessons.title: Rows and Reach
lessons.text: Melee attacks reach only the enemy's front row. Ranged attacks and spells hit any row.

lessons.title: The Ultimate
lessons.text: Your fourth skill is your ultimate. It wakes only after your first turns, so plan for the moment it is ready.

lessons.title: Rest, Skip and Move
lessons.text: Rest refills MP, Skip brings your next turn sooner, Move steps to an empty cell. Each uses your turn.

pages.text: Drag an item from the bag onto a hero or one of their slots to equip it.
Hover or select an item: the stats show how that hero would change before you commit.
In a hurry? Equip best picks the strongest items for the whole company.

lessons.title: Towns
lessons.text: Towns heal your company and raise the fallen. Tap a place in the village to use it; the road out moves on.

lessons.title: Your Company
lessons.text: Choose the heroes who carry the fight north. The first one you pick leads the company and always fights.

lessons.title: The Merchant
lessons.text: Odo buys and sells gear. Selling what you will not use frees room in the bag.

lessons.title: Formation
lessons.text: Open Formation to place your heroes. The front row takes the melee blows; keep the frail ones behind.

lessons.title: Roads
lessons.text: You can see two stops ahead. Choose your road: the others will close.

lessons.title: Statuses
lessons.text: Icons beside a health bar are statuses, like Slow or Wound. Hover or tap the unit to read what they do.

lessons.title: Area Shapes
lessons.text: Area skills hit a fixed shape of cells. The lit cells show exactly who gets caught.

lessons.title: Burning Ground
lessons.text: Burning ground hurts whoever stands on it when their turn begins. Step off it with Move.

lessons.title: Valor
lessons.text: Victories earn Valor. Spend it to raise a fallen hero, in battle or on the map.

lessons.title: Choices
lessons.text: Every choice here has a price: gold, health or a fight. The line under each option says exactly what it does.

lessons.title: Bosses
lessons.text: Bosses mark the cells they will strike next: step out before the blow lands. Stuns and slows do not work on them.

pages.title: Waves
pages.text: Endless is wave after wave, each one harder. Wounds carry over from one wave to the next.

pages.title: Camp
pages.text: After each victory you choose one reward, then rest at camp: gear up and fight the next wave when ready.

pages.title: Relics
pages.text: Every boss leaves a relic. Its power stays with your company for the whole run.

defeatHints._not: Bölüm III: aynı savaş minDefeats kez kaybedilince savaş başında mentor ipucu (karşılaşma id'sine göre; yoksa default).

byEncounter.ashen_plain: Their Undead raises and feeds on the fallen. Bring it down first, before the bodies pile up.
byEncounter.siege_line: Two Defenders wall the front. Use spells or ranged attacks on the Archer behind them.
byEncounter.dragons_spine: The Drake Priest is the real danger. Spread your heroes across lanes and focus him down.
byEncounter.ember_road: Their Cutthroat crits anyone with an empty cell behind them. Keep someone at your casters' backs.
byEncounter.riverhead: The Druid keeps the others standing. Kill the Druid first, then the Archers.
byEncounter.gate_of_cinders: The Paladin heals the wall in front. Reach the Paladin and the Mage before the Defenders.
byEncounter.lord_morvane: Morvane shrugs off stuns and slows. Clear his Paladin first, then save your ultimates for him.

defeatHints.default: Change the plan: put your sturdiest hero in front, keep healers behind, and strike the enemy's healer first.
